title: Activity HR zones (get_activity_hr_in_timezones)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's get_activity_hr_in_timezones(activity_id) as a flat list (this account/activity) — sync_activity_details also handles a {hrTimeInZones: [...]} wrapped shape defensively, not observed live here. Consumed by sync_activity_details (activity_hr_zones measurement).

Verified against: one real running activity, 2026-07-28 (activity_id 23765008303), 5 zones. Additional fields beyond what's listed here may exist and are tolerated (additionalProperties: true) — Garmin adding new fields is not a breaking change; a listed field disappearing or changing type is.
